notes: `v2` is candidate stopwords-v2: `current` plus `v2Additions`. It is screened alone under the general CI rule and joins L3 only if it passes dev alone.
`intro` and `introductory` go to the 3D intent parser, never the stopword list.
The code-join guard ('letters on the collision or stopword list') reads the stopword list in force. No v2 addition is a corpus prefix, so the guard is the same under `current` and `v2`.
